title: The Great Data Debate
summary: My last job was I ran marketing for a company, and I really went deep into growth marketing. For more on how the data space is evolving and who the key up-and-coming players are, check out the inaugural data 50 list on future.com forward slash data 50. We highlight and analyze the world's bellwether private companies across the most exciting categories in data, which in aggregate, are valued today at more than $100 billion, and have raised approximately $14 billion in total capital.

thesis: The episode debates the future of the modern data stack, specifically focusing on whether data lakes will eventually consume all data or if SQL-based data warehouses will subsume them. While one expert argues that data lakes are optimized for unstructured data and operational AI, another contends that relational SQL models will win over time by evolving to support complex data like images and videos, though full processing capabilities may require procedural logic like Python for the next decade.
